description: Use to check how close an organisation is to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, or to list the Annex A controls in practice. Call without answers to get 41 control checks in four themes (organizational, people, physical, technological) with their Annex A references. Call with a status per control (implemented, partial, planned, not_impl) to get a score per theme, a readiness level and the gaps.

answers.description: Control question id to status, e.g. {"o1": "implemented", "t3": "planned"}. Unanswered controls count as gaps.

name: iso27001_gap_assessment
title: ISO 27001 readiness gap assessment
